name: Son La

dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A northwest valley city on Highway 6, known for its old prison on a hill above the town. Visit the prison museum on Khau Ca hill, see the Da River dam, and eat smoked buffalo and pa pinh top grilled fish. One night suits travellers on the road to Dien Bien Phu.

seoTitle: Son La travel guide — the prison on Khau Ca, between Moc Chau and Dien Bien
seoDescription: Stop for the old prison on Khau Ca, the hill over the Nam La, on the Highway 6 road between Moc Chau and Dien Bien.
intro: The old prison’s stone walls stand on Khau Ca, and the town and the Nam La sit in the bowl under them. The ridges close the valley behind the hill. Stay if that night is the trip. Sleep in Moc Chau if you wanted the tea rows on the plateau before this city. Do not drive on to Dien Bien the same day when the hill over the town is the reason you stopped.

The bed is a small hotel or guesthouse in the town center. From 1 July 2025 that center is phường Tô Hiệu, the old Chiềng Lề market street. The other bed is a Thái stilt house at Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city. The name thành phố Sơn La is still in use, with the wards Chiềng Cơi and Quyết Thắng, and also phường Chiềng Cơi, tỉnh Sơn La, without the words thành phố. Two Saturday nights a month, Hoàng Quốc Việt is a walking street from 19:30 to 23:00, from the Highway 6 junction to the turn into bản Mé Ban.

Give the morning to the central market, then the climb to Khau Ca for the prison and the museum beside it. About one hour for the prison and about one hour for the museum, on one split. Late afternoon, the Lê Thái Tông temple looks back over the stream. Bản Mòng is the other half of the day, or the night in the stilt house. The dam on the Đà is a separate morning, north on Highway 279. The mistake is treating the museum ticket and the relic ticket as one price, or budgeting the whole day for a hill that sits in town.
gettingAround: The usual start is Hanoi, and the road is National Highway 6, past the Moc Chau plateau. Noi Bai is the airport travelers use. Nà Sản is in the national airport plan and is not a 2026 passenger service. Do not book a flight into it. No rail station is named.

In town, Highway 6 is the street the coaches use through the valley. Highway 279 leaves north for Mường La and the dam. The prison is a walk up Khau Ca from the center. Bản Mòng is a paved road to Hua La.

West, Highway 6 climbs Pha Đin toward Điện Biên. The pass is not this city. Yên Châu is the district town on this highway between Mộc Châu and the city. Hòa Bình is the city on the coach road toward Hanoi. Mai Châu is the valley before the plateau.

stayAreas.name: Town center
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and guesthouses on the old Chiềng Lề market street, inside phường Tô Hiệu from 1 July 2025. This is the bed under Khau Ca, a walk from the hill. No hotel brand is named.

stayAreas.name: Ban Mong
stayAreas.summary: Thái stilt houses at Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city. The spring Bó Nặm Ún and the lane are the reason to sleep here. The distance is about 5 km, nearly 6 km, or about 7 km. The water is a stable 36–38°C, and an outdoor average of 38°C is also given, milder in summer and hotter in winter. People come in any month.

eat: The meal is pa pỉnh tộp, hearth-smoked buffalo, cơm lam, xôi ngũ sắc, and rượu cần, at Bản Mòng or in town. Măng bói is at the city market, and chẩm chéo is the dip. Chợ Trung tâm is the morning hall on the old Chiềng Lề street, 8,940 m², hạng 2, now inside phường Tô Hiệu.
interestsBody: The meal is the Thái hearth at Bản Mòng or in town: the fish, the smoked buffalo, the bamboo tube, the five-color rice, and the jar.
The prison on Khau Ca is the reason to stop. The Đà River dam is the half-day north.

cards.title: The prison on Khau Ca
cards.summary: Walk the French prison on the hill in the morning. The museum is the same climb.

body: The prison stands on Khau Ca, in phường Tô Hiệu after 1 July 2025. You walk stone walls, four watchtowers, ground-floor and underground cells, a cistern, the cemetery and Tô Hiệu’s grave, and the peach tree he planted. Much of the original building is a ruin after the bombings of 1952 and 1965. It was ranked a special national relic on 31 December 2014. Morning is the easier hour. Around Tết the peach is the picture.
The museum beside the prison is the same walk. It holds more than 1,000 ancient Thái and Dao books, and more than 23,000 objects are also given.

cards.summary: Look at the dam from the public side at Ít Ong, a half-day north.

body: The plant is at Ít Ong, Mường La, on the Đà, inaugurated on 23 December 2012, with a capacity of 2,400 MW. It is about 40 km and about one hour north of the city, and also about 60 km. The outside view is free and the plant below the dam is closed. You may also be asked to register ahead, about 2–3 hours, free or very low.

Pá Uôn is the bridge farther along the reservoir road, after Mường La. It is 105 m from the ground to the deck with a middle span of 120 m, and also a deck 100 m above the lake, 918 m long, about 60 km northwest of the dam. The lakeside temples at Quỳnh Nhai are a different stop: a first-month incense ground, with a 32 m Quan Âm finished at the end of 2020.

blocks.heading: Central market
paragraphs: Chợ Trung tâm is the morning hall on the old Chiềng Lề street, Tổ 12, now inside phường Tô Hiệu. The hall is 8,940 m², hạng 2, solid, and it meets daily. The list was updated 10 July 2024.

blocks.heading: Cho 7-11
paragraphs: Chợ 7-11 is the other hạng 2 daily market, 6,615 m² on the same 2024 list, at Tổ 8, phường Quyết Thắng.

blocks.heading: Saturday stalls
paragraphs: Food stalls run on Hoàng Quốc Việt only on the walking-street nights, 19:30–23:00, two Saturdays a month, from the Highway 6 junction to bản Mé Ban. Other nights the street is an ordinary road.

faqs.a: Moc Chau is the tea plateau on Highway 6 before this city. Son La is the valley town after it, under Khau Ca. A tea-row morning is the plateau. The prison hill over the Nam La is this night. Dien Bien is the next valley, over Pha Đin, and it is not the same day.

faqs.q: How long is the road from Hanoi?
faqs.a: More than 300 km, about 300 km, 300 km to Mỹ Đình, and 293 km to Yên Nghĩa. The 2020 overnight run is about 7–8 hours, leaving Mỹ Đình about 19:00–20:00 and arriving about 7:00–8:00. A car of 6–7 hours is given for the road that continues to the dam, not a pure city-center time. The 2026 decision lists clocks and no duration.

faqs.q: What time does the prison open, and what is the ticket?
faqs.a: Hours are about 7:30–17:30 with a midday break, 7:30–18:30, and 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30. Relic tickets are 30,000 VND, 15,000 VND, and 5,000 VND. The museum is 10,000 VND from age 16, 5,000 VND from 10 to under 16, and free under 10. Ask at the gate which row is in force.

faqs.q: When is the Le temple festival?
faqs.a: The gathering is given as 15–17 of the first lunar month, and also as 22–24 of the first lunar month. The first city edition fell on 15–17 of the first lunar month in 2016. The civil dates move with the moon.

season.label: Dry road from October to April
season.note: October–April are the dry months and May–September the rain. November–January at the lake is given as 10–18°C. Thick fog sits on Pha Đin in December–February. June–August rain is the stretch to avoid on the pass. The Tô Hiệu peach flowers around Tết, and the civil dates move. The Lê temple gathering is 15–17 or 22–24 of the first lunar month. September is named for Hmong independence days, without a day.
